採用・広告の製品.quote: Increase submissions, improve underwriting results and automate your back office with PolicyFly
No more portals. Automatically ingest and process any submission from any source, in any format with PolicyFly Capture.

"PolicyFly Capture has revolutionised how we handle submissions. What used to take 20+ minutes per submission is now automated in seconds, giving our underwriters the time to focus on evaluating risks instead of rekeying data. It’s a game-changer for improving bind ratios and staying ahead of the competition"
Enrich submissions with third-party data, collaborate with your team or partners and provide robust quote optionality in seconds.

PolicyFly’s reporting suite gives insurers real-time insights into submission flow, bind rates, and risk performance—helping you refine pricing, optimize underwriting, and track claims impact. See which risks convert, where you’re losing business, and how your portfolio is performing, all in one powerful analytics platform.
PolicyFly is SOC 2 Type II compliant, ensuring industry-leading security, rigorous access controls, and continuous monitoring to protect sensitive data.
Additionally, all users are protected with two factor authentication.
Your Startup MGA Doesn’t Have a Technology Problem
MGA, MGUs and Program Administrators

Specialty insurance is built on risk—but for too long, the real risk has been inefficiency. Emails, spreadsheets, and disconnected systems have slowed down business, buried underwriters in manual work, and left valuable data untapped.

In 2018 we set out to change that. After years working with insurers, we saw the same problems repeated: underwriters drowning in submissions, agents stuck in outdated workflows, and lost opportunities due to fragmented systems.
Each Program is Unique
Insurance Innovation Process
We start by understanding your program. How can we streamline the process? What data providers can we use to cut down on questions?
From application to bind, we design the fastest way for agents or customers to interface with your program.
We then rapidly launch your program in weeks -- not months, with the initial platform running in days.
Allow your program to continuously scale and evolve by taking advantage of ongoing PolicyFly innovations.
Today, PolicyFly has processed over $1B in specialty premium, and with the backing of Bain Capital Ventures, Y Combinator, Viewpoint, and Susa Ventures, we’re continuing to push the industry forward.

The challenges brought us to this space, but it’s the people, relationships, and customers who motivate us to do better every day. We’re inspired by the MGAs, carriers, and underwriters who work tirelessly to insure the hard-to-insure, solve complex risks, and bring specialty programs to life.

“Specialty insurers often face challenges balancing complex policy workflows with financial operations like reconciliation, payment processing, and reporting,” said Cory Crosland, CEO of PolicyFly. “By combining our expertise in policy workflows with Functional Finance’s automation capabilities, we’re eliminating inefficiencies and empowering insurers to focus on growth and customer satisfaction.”

PolicyFly’s platform has earned a reputation as a reliable solution for policy administration, enabling insurers to manage everything from submission intake and underwriting to endorsements, cancellations, reinstatements, and reporting. By streamlining these processes, PolicyFly helps insurers reduce time-to-quote and better manage submission volumes, key challenges in the specialty market.

Functional Finance complements PolicyFly’s capabilities by automating financial workflows that often fall between policy administration systems and accounting. Tasks like reconciliation, payment categorization, and cash transfers are traditionally labor-intensive and prone to errors. Functional Finance eliminates these challenges, providing real-time reconciliation and financial clarity.

“Finance operations in the insurance industry are often still handled through spreadsheets and manual work,” said Rashmi Melgiri, CEO of Functional Finance. “You know what the premium is, but then comes the question: how do you collect it? How do you reconcile it? That’s where Functional Finance steps in, automating these processes so insurers don’t have to worry about it.”

As insurers grow, their needs evolve, and many legacy systems can’t keep up. The partnership ensures insurers can adapt to new challenges without introducing inefficiencies. PolicyFly and Functional Finance are designed to evolve alongside their customers, providing scalability and addressing new complexities as they arise.

This partnership is already transforming operations for specialty insurers, helping them reduce delays, improve accuracy, and operate more efficiently. By automating submission intake, underwriting, billing, and reconciliation, PolicyFly and Functional Finance are setting a new standard for what insurers can expect from their technology partners.

“At the heart of this collaboration is a shared commitment to solving real problems for our customers,” Crosland said. “We’re not just making processes easier—we’re helping insurers focus on what matters most: serving their customers and growing their business.”
Mid-Century Marketing Co. // Functional Finance

The Functional Finance platform enables insurance operators to manage their financial back office ranging from billing, premium finance, payables, and other money movement functionality.
